item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Square Crop Keeps Whole Sneaker

turns.text: Make this wide photo square for an Instagram post. Keep the whole sneaker in view, and don't stretch it or change anything else.

item.tests: Tests converting a 16:9 photo to square while preserving the complete subject and its proportions.

answer_sheet.Subject to preserve: The entire white sneaker, including the toe and heel.
answer_sheet.Style, text and other edits: Keep the original photo appearance. No added text or other edits.

must_haves: The sneaker is the same white leather sneaker as in the attachment.
The entire sneaker, including toe, heel and sole, remains visible.
The sneaker has natural proportions, without stretching or squeezing.
The retained floor and background match the source photo, with no added text or decorative elements.

turns.text: Make this pic square for Instagram, keeping the whole sneaker visible without stretching it or changing anything else. Quick pls.
turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the edit because your account has insufficient credits, so no image was made.

Quick workaround: choose **Square / 1:1 → Fit** in a photo editor and add gray padding above and below. Don’t use Fill or Crop—this keeps the whole sneaker visible without stretching or changing the photo.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Make this photograph square ONLY by adding neutral solid-color padding above and below the original image, matching the gray tabletop color. Keep the entire original rectangular photograph intact centered within the square, with all original image content unchanged. Do not crop any part of the sneaker or original image. Preserve the entire sneaker, its exact proportions, details, colors, lighting and original background. No stretching, no retouching, no redesign, no objects added; only expand the canvas to 1:1 with plain padding.
